  • Develop and manage the sales pipeline and revenue forecast.
  • Set monthly, quarterly, and annual enterprise sales targets and ensure the team consistently hits its sales goals.
  • Act as a coach and mentor for direct reports.
  • Develop and maintain relationships with key customers, partners, and stakeholders to drive revenue growth.
  • Continuously analyze market trends, competitive landscape, and customer needs to identify growth opportunities and develop strategies to capitalize on them.
  • Create and manage revenue-related budgets, forecasts, and financial plans.
  • Work collaboratively with other departments to ensure alignment and to achieve revenue goals.
  • Establish and maintain a culture of excellence, performance, and accountability.
  • Act and be perceived as an executive presence on large enterprise deals.
  • Collaborate with leadership to understand prospect and customer pain points.
  • Deliver insightful, clear, and articulate communication with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Own the planning for our next phase of growth so we're well-prepared to hire additional sales executives and channel managers and get them onboarded effectively.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of leadership experience within a sales/revenue function (I.e., new logo sales, channel business development, account management)
  • A minimum of 5+ years of sales leadership experience in a B2B SaaS environment
  • A minimum of 3+ years of experience owning all facets of a sales team (hiring, onboarding, quota and territory assignments, sales enablement, scalable processes, forecasting, budgeting, resource allocation, reporting)
  • Experience scaling a company from $25M to over $50M ARR
  • Experience selling into Mid Market and Large Enterprises, selling deal sizes $20-100k+ ARR, in both North America and Europe.
  • Proven track record of building and leading high-performing sales teams of at least 7+ people, and delivering significant revenue growth.
  • Experience with value-based selling methodologies, including for the following stages: Discovery, Qualification, Business Case, Demonstration, Validation, and Negotiating the Close. Ability to coach and develop our sales team with these disciplines.
  • Experience in developing and executing revenue growth strategies for SaaS businesses in a locked partnership with Marketing, including Account-based programs.
  • Demonstrable success selling to C-suite economic buyers in Enterprise accounts
  • Excellent analytical and strategic thinking skills.
  • Strong experience using Salesforce and sales outreach tools (i.e., Outreach, Salesloft, etc.)
  • Strong leadership, communication (written and oral presentation), and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively across departments and with external partners and stakeholders
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work in a fast-paced environment
  • Has led a geographically dispersed team (must have)
  • Has dealt with acquisitions and integrations of companies/products post acquisition (nice to have)
  • Must be authorized to work in Canada, the USA, the UK, or Western EU.
  • Must be open to some travel - up to 20%
  • Experience leading expansion across business units, divisions, brands, and geographies

Swapcard’s Interview process

  1. Screening Interview with a recruiter from our people team.
  2. A remote exercise to demonstrate and assess your skills.
  3. Manager review with your future reporting manager
  4. Leadership review with one of our department leaders
  5. Reference check conducted by our people team
  6. Offer

Swapcard's Values

Curious : We ask questions and try new things. We embrace new experiences and love to learn from others. We are curious about what something is and WHY something is.

Open-minded : We welcome change as well as ideas and feedback from others. We welcome people as they are and learn from each other's personal and professional experiences.

️ Human : No masking who we are. Empathy encourages a down-to-earth environment where we all feel comfortable and free to be human. Creating bonds makes it easier to share ideas, give feedback, and ask for help.

Resilient : Our challenges in life have only made us stronger and wiser. We prefer the term “experiment” over “failure” because we always keep trying. We are solution-oriented and find innovative approaches to succeed.

Ambitious: Nothing is impossible. We're always striving to get better, seize opportunities, and reach the top. We are encouraged to dream big and believe in ourselves.

Benefits & Reasons to Join Swapcard

  • International team with 40+ nationalities (more on the way!)
  • Remote-first policy with headquarters in Paris
  • Thriving startup with career growth opportunities
  • Open-minded culture that appreciates differences
  • Feedback-driven, supportive & curious team with a DIY mindset
  • Generous Paid Time Off to ensure you have time for what matters most ️
  • Remote perks designed to optimize your working experience
  • In-person social gatherings to celebrate our achievements ️
  • 100% of your health insurance contribution paid by Swapcard
  • Work-from-home budget (one-off contribution for equipment in addition to your initial equipment setup) ️
  • Co-working space budget to support remote work in professional environments
  • Learning budget to help you develop new and existing skills
  • Mental health care initiatives to support your well-being

Equal Opportunity

Swapcard is committed to upholding equal employment practices and making merit-based employment decisions. We welcome individuals from all backgrounds, abilities, and experiences to apply, regardless of race, nationality, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy status, age, marital status, and status as a veteran

title: Social Media Content Creator
description:
Sobre a Wave

Na Wave, a gente faz diferente.

Nosso foco é em estratégia 360, com entregas criativas, profundas e personalizadas para cada cliente. Preocupamo-nos de verdade com nossos parceiros e com nossa equipe: não acreditamos em sobrecarga, nem em encher a agenda de clientes só por encher.

Aqui, prezamos por qualidade e profundidade em cada projeto, porque sabemos que é isso que gera resultados consistentes. Nossa cultura é leve, colaborativa e criativa, sempre com espaço para crescimento e autonomia.

Sobre a vaga

Estamos procurando um(a) Social Media & Designer para integrar nosso time e cuidar da criação de conteúdo estratégico para os clientes da Wave.

Buscamos alguém que não apenas execute, mas que pense, proponha e traga soluções criativas no dia a dia.

Perfil comportamental

Queremos alguém que seja :

  • Criativo(a), proativo(a) e independente.
  • Responsável, com perfil ativo, influente e dominante (na medida certa).
  • Capaz de se posicionar de forma assertiva e segura, sem ser agressivo.
  • Comunicativo(a), com boa desenvoltura oral e escrita (para reuniões e apresentações).
  • Autêntico(a) – sem forçar um personagem, sendo seguro(a) do que faz e fala.
  • Resolutivo(a), que saiba se sair bem em diferentes situações.
  • Curioso(a), sempre em busca de novas ideias, tendências e soluções criativas.

Perfil técnico

Esperamos que você tenha experiência com :

  • Criação de estratégias de conteúdo para redes sociais.
  • Redação e legendagem de posts, com noção de copywriting.
  • Agendamento e gestão de postagens.
  • Design para social media.
  • Ferramentas: Photoshop, Illustrator e Canva (para demandas rápidas).
  • Edição de vídeo (CapCut ou similar).
  • Entendimento básico de métricas de redes sociais e relatórios.
  • Noção em Ads, e-mail marketing e publicações de blog (diferencial).
  • Inteligência Artificial aplicada à publicidade: como usar IA para brainstorm de ideias, otimização de processos, testes de copies, automações criativas etc.

Formação e experiência

  • Formação superior não é obrigatória (mas cursos ou graduações na área contam pontos).
  • Importante ter buscado conhecimento formal (cursos, workshops, especializações).
  • Desejável mínimo de 2 anos de experiência em Social Media e / ou Design.

O que oferecemos

  • Salário : R$ 3.500 (contrato PJ).
  • Modelo de trabalho : 100% remoto (anywhere office).
  • Liberdade e autonomia para organizar sua rotina (não temos controle rígido de horário).
  • Reuniões pontuais de alinhamento, apenas quando necessário.
  • Ambiente criativo, com oportunidade real de crescimento dentro da agência.

title: Software Maintenance Engineer
description:
Join or sign in to find your next job

Join to apply for the Software Maintenance Engineer role at Canonical

1 day ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Software Maintenance Engineer role at Canonical

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring a Software Maintenance Engineer to…
…work in a dynamic and exciting engineering role in Linux-based infrastructure and applications, covering all layers of the stack, including bare metal, virtualization (KVM), containerization (Docker/LXC/LXD), storage (Ceph and Linux filesystems), networking (OVS, OVN and Core networking), OpenStack, Kubernetes and the open source applications running on top of them. It will challenge you to show the breadth of your engineering skills, which will be needed to work on almost any aspect of Ubuntu and the open source applications large enterprise customers run.
This role is an opportunity for a technologist with a passion for Linux and open source to build a career with Canonical and drive success for our customers, community and the company. If you have an affinity for open source software, great communication skills, and a passion for troubleshooting and fixing issues in technology used by millions across the world, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.
This role deals with critical issues in the open source stack that require upstream bug fixes. Our engineers are able to work productively at any level of the stack including the kernel and in a wide range of languages, to understand and address the software issues at hand. Our group is critical to the success of our customers, partners and Ubuntu itself.
You will help with troubleshooting and driving issues to resolution with workarounds, guidance, and bug fixes to be released upstream and in Ubuntu.
Location: This is a remote role, we have teams in all time zones.
The role entails

  • Resolve complex customer problems related to Ubuntu, Kernel, Ceph, OpenStack, or Kubernetes and other open source software
  • Maintain a close working relationship with Canonical's Field, Support and product engineering teams
  • Participate in upstream communities
  • Develop bug fixes, backport patches, and work with upstream for inclusion
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Demonstrate good judgment in technical methods and techniques
  • Prioritize work and manage your time effectively against those priorities
  • Participate in team discussions to improve processes, tools, and documentation
  • Maintain clear, technical and concise communications
  • Work from home and travel internationally up to 10% of work time for team meetings, events and conferences
What we are looking for in you
  • An exceptional academic track record
  • Background in Computer Science, STEM or similar
  • Experience with Linux and open source software
  • Experience with at least one of Python, Go, C or C++ on Linux
  • A drive to learn unfamiliar technology and deep-dive difficult issues
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events
Nice-to-have skills
  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
  • You have interest in, or willingness to learn about any of the following: Ubuntu Linux - kernel or userspace, Kubernetes, OpenStack, Ceph, QEMU/KVM, LXC/LXD,Postgresql, Mongo, Debian packaging, distributed systems
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora Full Stack (Python ou PowerShell) | Pleno
description:
Overview

Aqui na Viaflow, atuamos 100% remotos e nesta oportunidade, buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack experiente, com domínio em APIs e automação, para liderar a migração de ferramentas e dados da Google Cloud Platform (GCP) para o Microsoft Azure. Este profissional será responsável por planejar, executar e validar a transição de serviços, garantindo segurança, escalabilidade e performance para nosso cliente.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Domínio da Plataforma de Destino (Microsoft Azure):
    • Serviços Cloud: Profundo conhecimento do Azure, incluindo serviços de computação (Máquinas Virtuais, Azure Functions), armazenamento (Blob Storage, Azure SQL Database), redes e segurança (Azure Active Directory, agora Microsoft Entra ID).
    • Identidade e Autenticação: Experiência em configurar o Microsoft Entra ID para gerenciar usuários, grupos e acessos, e como ele se integra com as novas ferramentas. Isso é crucial para garantir a segurança.
    • Ferramentas e APIs: Familiaridade com as APIs da Microsoft, especialmente o Microsoft Graph , que é a porta de entrada para dados de serviços como Outlook, OneDrive, Teams e SharePoint.
  • Experiência com a Plataforma de Origem (Google Cloud Platform - GCP):
    • Conhecimento em GCP: Entender como os serviços do Google (como Google Cloud Storage, BigQuery, Compute Engine) funcionam para saber como extrair e mover os dados e aplicações de forma eficiente.
    • APIs do Google: Habilidade para usar as APIs do Google Workspace e GCP para automatizar a extração de dados (por exemplo, mover arquivos do Google Drive ou e-mails do Gmail).
  • Habilidades de Programação e Automação:
    • Linguagens de Programação: Proficiência em linguagens de script como Python ou PowerShell para automatizar a migração de dados e a configuração de infraestrutura (IaC - Infrastructure as Code).
    • Infraestrutura como Código (IaC): Conhecimento de ferramentas como Terraform ou Bicep (a ferramenta nativa do Azure) para criar e gerenciar a infraestrutura na nuvem de forma repetível e segura.

Experiência desejável

  • Graduação em Tecnologia (concluída ou em andamento).
  • Certificações Azure ou GCP.
  • Experiência com migração de ambientes corporativos.
  • Conhecimento em containers (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Inglês técnico para leitura de documentação.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Planejar e executar a migração de aplicações, dados e serviços da GCP para o Azure.
  • Desenvolver scripts e automações em Python ou PowerShell para extração, transformação e carga de dados.
  • Utilizar ferramentas de IaC como Terraform ou Bicep para provisionamento de infraestrutura no Azure.
  • Integrar e consumir APIs da Microsoft (especialmente Microsoft Graph) e Google Workspace.
  • Configurar e gerenciar identidade e acesso via Microsoft Entra ID.
  • Garantir conformidade com políticas de segurança e boas práticas de arquitetura cloud.
  • Realizar testes de integração, validação de dados e monitoramento pós-migração.

Informações adicionais

Oportunidade para projeto temporário: 6 meses.

title: Consultant, Global Pricing & Access (Remote)
description:
At EVERSANA, we are proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work across the globe. We’re fueled by our vision to create a healthier world. How? Our global team of more than 7,000 employees is committed to creating and delivering next-generation commercialization services to the life sciences industry. We are grounded in our cultural beliefs and serve more than 650 clients ranging from innovative biotech start-ups to established pharmaceutical companies. Our products, services and solutions help bring innovative therapies to market and support the patients who depend on them. Our jobs, skills and talents are unique, but together we make an impact every day. Join us!

Across our growing organization, we embrace diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Improving patient lives around the world is a priority, and we need people from all backgrounds and swaths of life to help build the future of the healthcare and the life sciences industry. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive culture that embraces our cultural beliefs. We are deliberate and self-reflective about the kind of team and culture we are building. We look for team members that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but also who care deeply about EVERSANA, our people, clients and most importantly, the patients we serve. We are EVERSANA.

THE TEAM

Our Global Pricing & Market Access (PMA) team at Navlin is a dynamic, international group that combines deep inhouse expertise with real-time intelligence—from pricing and HTA updates to regulatory news—via Navlin’s industry-benchmark platform. Empowered by advanced price-management software and launch-sequence simulation tools (navlin.com), we deliver strategic, well-informed recommendations on pricing and access for our clients.

Composed of top talent from across Europe, our multicultural team blends local market nuance with creative synergy. We embrace a flexible remote-working model—fully supported by robust IT tools—and maintain satellite offices in London, Berlin, and Milan, freely accessible to all team members. Our team is rapidly expanding with consistent year-on-year growth.

Our project portfolio includes critical initiatives such as, among others, launch sequencing and pricing strategies for ATMPs and orphan drugs, indication-expansion planning, LOE strategy, forecasting, and asset due diligence—spanning Europe and global markets. While a dedicated team oversees U.S. initiatives, we lead global efforts across Europe, APAC, and LATAM.

We also collaborate closely with EVERSANA’s internal functions—commercial, HEOR, medical affairs, and others— in global launch execution projects, ensuring PMA remains central to global launch execution of new assets

THE POSITION

The Consultant, Global Pricing and Market Access position will be involved in delivering client consultancy projects and helping to manage project-related analytics, data and tools available through our industry platform Navlin or dedicated secondary and primary research. The Consultant will ensure that tasks within client projects or internal activities are delivered to schedule, while maintaining the highest level of quality and value expectations.

The Consultant will lead research and analysis focused around: pricing, market access launch strategy, competitor research, value-based pricing analyses, HTA, etc. The Consultant will be involved in identifying client needs and problems and implementing robust strategic and data driven solutions, while managing own workload to prepare the client deliverables. In addition, the Consultant will also contribute to business development through the development of proposals. Activities will be executed under the guidance of an Engagement Manager, mainly remotely due to remote team composition. In some cities with physical EVERSANA offices, the Consultant is fully able to use the company office, as well.

The role is home office based, (full-time position), located in Italy, Remote.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Our consultants are tasked with delivering excellent business results through the efforts of the project team. These results are achieved by:

  • Designing and executing client analyses & deliverables
  • Developing client reports and presentations and delivery of all or significant portions of findings to client
  • Providing follow-up with client after project deliverable has been completed to ensure client satisfaction
  • Leveraging business experience and acumen in identifying strategic alternatives and project approach to client questions, applying a solution-orientated approach and looking to add client value wherever possible
  • Developing of intellectual property for use on future engagements
  • Developing broader and deeper knowledge of consulting methodologies and life science know-how through on-the-job experience and training
  • Applying high attention to quality and detail with strong written and spoken English
  • Applying excellent PowerPoint and Excel skills, and ability to present information in compelling and creative ways (story telling through data, insights, effective slides)
  • Occasional management of more junior resources, such as associate consultants or interns
  • Working effectively in a remote environment, often with limited face-to-face contact with team members and client counterparts
  • However, working under supervision of a more senior member of the team, usually with daily alignments on operative tasks.

MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES

The requirements listed below are representative of the experience, education, knowledge, skill and/or abilities required.

  • B.S./B.A in relevant field of study required (life sciences or economic/managerial sciences, medical engineering).
  • 2-4 years of pharmaceutical, medical/health industry-related experience and/or 2-4 years management consulting experience
  • Understanding of life sciences business practices and the issues clients face in specific segments of responsibility
  • Strong conceptual, analytic and problem-solving skills
  • Strong knowledge of the market research development process
  • Strong quantitative and qualitative market research skills.
  • Proficiency in MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook
  • Ability to structure and use large amounts of data and other types of information from multiple sources to complete a final analysis of a business question/situations and make recommendations
  • Ability to work under pressure, meet deadlines, and work on several projects and multiple tasks simultaneously
  • Demonstrated self-awareness and accountability
  • Ability to lead and own personal projects
  • Ability to establish credibility in front of clients at companies
  • Willingness and ability to travel approximately up to 10% of annual worktime, mainly for off-site company events

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Advanced degree (e.g., MBA, MS, MPH).
  • Background in International Pricing and Market Access, analytics and modelling/forecasting would be a plus to effectively lead Global Pricing and Market Access projects for key clients.
  • 2+ years of management consulting experience.

Additional Information

Patient Minded I act with the patient’s best interest in mind.

Client Delight I own every client experience and its impact on results.

Take Action I am empowered and hold myself accountable.

Embrace Diversity I create an environment of awareness and respect.

Grow Talent I own my development and invest in the development of others.

Win Together I passionately connect with anyone, anywhere, anytime to achieve results.

Communication Matters I speak up to create transparent, thoughtful, and timely dialogue.

Always Innovate I am bold and creative in everything I do.

Our team is aware of recent fraudulent job offers in the market, misrepresenting EVERSANA. Recruitment fraud is a sophisticated scam commonly perpetrated through online services using fake websites, unsolicited e-mails, or even text messages claiming to be a legitimate company. Some of these scams request personal information and even payment for training or job application fees. Please know EVERSANA would never require personal information nor payment of any kind during the employment process. We respect the personal rights of all candidates looking to explore careers at EVERSANA.

From EVERSANA’s inception, Diversity, Equity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. description:
Overview

Marketing Analytics | Sênior (Remoto) at Stone

Somos uma empresa de tecnologia e serviços financeiros focada no cliente. Nosso propósito é transformar a indústria de pagamentos, servindo o empreendedor brasileiro e gerando resultados. Somos a maior empresa independente de meios de pagamentos do Brasil, com mais de quinze mil pessoas em todo o país. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a flexibilidade, o desenvolvimento contínuo e pensamentos disruptivos na busca de soluções para a nossa missão.

Nossa Cultura

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por 5 pilares: Own It, Live the Ride, No Bullshit, Team Play, The Reason. Queremos gerar impacto para nossos clientes por meio de entregas relevantes.

Missão Do Time De Marketing Analytics

A área de Marketing Analytics tem como principal objetivo monitorar e otimizar a performance das campanhas de mídia, integrando dados de diversas fontes e fornecendo análises que apoiem decisões estratégicas. Buscamos alguém com forte capacidade analítica, domínio técnico em manipulação de dados (foco em SQL e BigQuery) e conhecimento em mídia paga (Google, Meta, programática, entre outros).

Como é Ser Um(a) Analista De Marketing Analytics

Essa pessoa será responsável por acompanhar e interpretar os principais KPIs das campanhas, gerar hipóteses e testes para melhoria de performance, propor insights acionáveis e garantir a visibilidade dos resultados para os stakeholders. As principais atividades a serem executadas serão:

  • Realizar análises profundas de canais, audiências, criativos e jornada de conversão;
  • Analisar o desempenho das campanhas de mídia digital;
  • Criar e manter dashboards automatizados em ferramentas como Looker Studio ou similares;
  • Manipular grandes volumes de dados usando SQL e BigQuery;
  • Levantar hipóteses com base em dados e validar com testes A/B ou análises comparativas;
  • Apoiar a definição de metas e KPIs junto aos times de marketing e negócios;
  • Trabalhar próximo das áreas de mídia, CRM, branding e produto para priorizar iniciativas com base em impacto;
  • Acompanhar e interpretar métricas de atribuição, CAC, LTV, ROI e outras métricas relevantes;
  • Criar documentação clara e objetiva dos aprendizados das análises realizadas.

O Que Esperamos De Você

  • Experiência prévia em Marketing Analytics, mídia de performance ou áreas correlatas;
  • Domínio de SQL e experiência com BigQuery;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de visualização de dados como Looker Studio, Power BI ou Tableau;
  • Sólido conhecimento de KPIs de marketing e funis de conversão;
  • Capacidade de traduzir dados em histórias claras e estratégicas para diferentes públicos.

O Que Aumentam Suas Chances

  • Experiência com modelagem de atribuição ou marketing mix modeling;
  • Conhecimento em Python ou R para análises estatísticas;
  • Vivência com ferramentas de automação de marketing; experiência em ambientes com squads multidisciplinares.

Jornada De Trabalho

  • 8 horas diárias + 1h de intervalo | Escala: 5x2 | Segunda a Sexta.

Modelo/Local De Trabalho

  • Remoto. Se a pessoa residir em SP capital, o time irá ao escritório de forma periódica.

Nossos Benefícios

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico
  • Hospital Digital, da Vitta
  • Vale Refeição e/ou Vale Alimentação - Sodexo
  • Gympass
  • Auxílio Creche
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Vale Transporte
  • Convênio SESC
  • Salário Fixo
  • Remuneração Variável (em alguns cargos)
  • Benefício Educação - Plataforma interna com acesso a diversos livros, podcasts, treinamentos e vídeo aulas (Studa e Biblioteca StoneCo)

Etapas Do Processo Seletivo

Inscrição: realize seu cadastro e faça alguns testes. Nosso time analisará as informações do seu perfil e entrará em contato em breve.

Entrevistas com o time de People: conheça nossa cultura, estrutura e o desafio proposto.

Entrevista com a Liderança: aprofundamento em hard skills, com área para apresentar um case.

Check de Cultura: alinhamento com a nossa cultura e crenças.

Feedback: ofereceremos retorno sobre o processo, independente do resultado.

Overview

Talent Scout is seeking a Social Media Manager for a part-time contract role. Our client is a Strategic Storytelling Studio that partners with mission-driven organizations to produce research-backed, story-based campaigns that deliver measurable impact. Powered by StoryHeat—a proprietary storytelling testing and analytics platform—they merge audience research, strategy, and campaign activation into one seamless process. Their campaigns focus on issues like clean energy in rural America and workforce development in critical industries, where storytelling has the power to shift perception and inspire action.

Role

We’re seeking a Social Media Strategist to bring strategies to life across digital platforms. This is a part-time contract role designed for someone who can take structured social strategies and carry them through to execution—creating, publishing, and optimizing content that resonates with audiences. You’ll translate research and campaign objectives into compelling, accessible social posts aligned with broader storytelling goals. The role is hands-on: you’ll be expected to both think strategically and deliver creative assets that drive measurable results.

  • Execute social media campaigns for client accounts and the agency’s own channels.

  • Draft social copy that adapts tone and message for different audiences.
  • Track content performance and provide real-time insights to optimize campaigns.
  • Collaborate with the team to brainstorm creative concepts and maintain brand consistency.

What We’re Looking For

  • 3–5 years of experience in social media management, content creation, or digital strategy.

  • Proficiency with tools such as Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, CapCut, Descript, or similar.
  • Highly independent and proactive, able to take a strategy brief and run with it.
  • Strong project management skills and ability to meet deadlines.
  • Interest in advocacy, storytelling, and mission-driven campaigns.

Reporting Structure

This role reports to the Managing Director , with close collaboration during onboarding and campaign setup. After an initial ramp-up, you’ll be expected to operate independently, carrying strategy through execution with minimal oversight.

title: Direct Response Copywriter
description:
Overview

Pure is looking for a Direct Response Copywriter to join our team! As our creative head, you will be responsible for the ideation, scripting, planning, and managing of the entire creative process with a big focus on UGC ads and psychology-based creatives to be used across paid marketing channels.

We are looking to hire someone with 3+ years of work experience. The ideal candidate has prior experience in creating paid advertisements specifically for Meta Platforms, UGC, direct response marketing & bonus points if experience with influencer / UGC partnerships.

Who are we?

At Pure, we are dedicated to transforming lives by creating high-quality supplements backed by science and trusted by our growing community. Our mission is to make achieving better health simpler, more effective, and more accessible for everyone. Since our launch, we’ve scaled rapidly through viral digital marketing and built a passionate customer base that loves and trusts our products. We operate with a small but mighty team that thrives on innovation, data-driven growth, and relentless creativity—and we’re excited to bring on a Creative Strategist to play a pivotal role in scaling our brand even further.

What is our culture like & who is a good fit?

Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We utilize creativity to do more with less - and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by the following three core values : "work smart", "overdeliver", "speed is king" and "better everyday". We love learning - every problem is an opportunity to grow. If you want a stress-free corporate 9-5 job, this isn\u2019t it.

If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founders- and play a huge role in scaling it to $12M+ a year. Drive results with a group of passionate, smart & hardworking fun people. Work in an environment without politics, or corporate chicanery. Play a big part in our growth being hands on, active, and doing what is necessary with an excellent bonus plan based on performance then you have come to the right place.

Key Objectives

  • Manage the full creative process (from scripting all the way to final creative) in order to produce high converting creatives on an ongoing basis.
  • Work with our content manager to find, manage and source new content to be used across all marketing channels
  • Drive measurable improvements in core advertising metrics across digital channels with improved creatives.
  • Script UGC Direct response creatives
  • Use data from creative performance on Meta to dissect, analyze and improve upon our creatives to continuously improve performance across our creatives.
  • Work with our marketing team to come up with new creative concepts and ideas.
  • Conduct strategic customer and competitor research to better optimize creative efforts
  • Provide creative reports on a monthly and quarterly basis
  • Decide on the next steps needed to scale Meta Ads further through better creative

Requirements

  • Fully remote
  • Fluent in English
  • Direct Response Expertise: 3+ Years Experience with performance creative for DTC brands or working at a creative agency is a must.
  • Tools & Metrics: Proficiency in performance analytics tools such as Triple Whale, Motion, pitch decks, and spreadsheets to present ideas and campaign outcomes effectively.
  • UGC Experience: Lots of experience with creating briefs for UGC creators to produce high converting content across paid channels.
  • Creative & Analytical Mindset: Ability to generate fresh ideas, write scripts, shot listing, and make data-driven decisions based on ad performance.
  • No issue working overtime or on weekends if needed. You wouldn\u2019t know what to do with your free time if you were working less. You are passionate about your work.
  • Excellent cultural fit as per our values above.
  • Are excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founders.
  • Basic psychology-based copywriting skills

Accountabilities

  • Brainstorm and pitch weekly ad ideas aligned with direct response principles.
  • Write 80-100 high-converting ad scripts per week for Meta Platforms
  • Come up with static ad ideas on a weekly basis
  • Analyze performance metrics to derive actionable insights for future campaigns.
  • Collaborate with editors and designers to ensure ads are visually compelling and on-brand.
  • Adapt ad strategies to capitalize on emerging internet trends and consumer behaviors.
  • Present performance analyses and creative strategies to the marketing team
  • Continuously refine ad concepts and troubleshoot underperforming campaigns to achieve maximum ROI.
  • Iterate on winning ads to create more winning assets to produce a better ROI.

How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate

When hiring, we’ll work with you to define the KPIs you’ll be responsible for and set targets. This removes ambiguity around wondering if you’re doing a good job after you start.

Initial soft interview, then a technical interview + test project with the current head of marketing, and a final interview to ensure culture fit. We plan to hire within ~8 - 10 days of conducting these interviews. We pride ourselves on timely responses and updates for applicants.

For this specific role, we will walk you through the long-term vision and opportunities that have us excited about this business - and how you fit in. We will show you our current structure and where we are headed!

Salary Expectation

USD $36,000 USD to $70,000 USD per year + Performance Bonus Structure based on experience and expertise.

CLEARANCE TYPE: SCI TRAVEL: Yes, 10% of the Time

Overview

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people\'s lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation\'s history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they\'re making history.

The Payload and Ground Systems Division within Northrop Grumman Space Systems is a strategic partner specializing in delivering intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance solutions for classified and unclassified missions in space. Headquartered in Linthicum, Maryland, PGS RSP has offices, manufacturing, and world-class assembly, integration, and test facilities. We do it all here, on-site, from sensors to payloads to full up spacecraft, supporting Class A to Class D missions. Our key capabilities include Active RF, Passive RF, and Electro-Optical payloads, space solar power, cross domain missions, and space resilience payloads & solutions.

This position is for a Staff Systems Engineer to join our Remote Sensing Programs Systems Engineering, Integration and Test (RSP SEIT) team as a SEIT Lead . As a member of this team, you will have the opportunity to support efforts on both concept and product development to deliver key solutions to our customers. We cover a wide variety of expertise within the systems engineering domain. This includes mission engineering, requirements, architecture, modeling and simulation, integration and test, verification, and validation, and many more!

The SEIT Lead is responsible for directing the execution of the overall systems engineering, integration, and test (SEIT) effort on the program and is responsible for horizontal and vertical integration across all engineering elements of the program. The ideal candidate ensures the integrity of engineering processes and timely development of core engineering work products. The SEIT Lead typically has Control Account Manager (CAM) responsibility, which comprises cost and schedule management for the SEIT work scope. And interfaces with the Program Manager, Chief Engineer, System Architect, other engineering team leads, as well as the customer.

The position will be responsible for leading systems engineering tasks for space subsystems, payloads and/or vehicles. These may include, but are not limited to:

  • Serve as the cost account manager for the systems engineering (and potentially multiple other organizations) responsibilities.
  • Plan and execute the core functions and ensure the project team has qualified staff to execute the program core functions.
  • Lead technical management and execution of the SE team.
  • Plan, execute, and close out program reviews and milestones (e.g., SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR, etc.)
  • Ensure system technical compliance with the program Statement of Work (SOW), system requirements, and manage scope control of technical team.
  • Manage the vertical and horizontal technical integration throughout the product teams and program life cycle.
  • Oversee configuration management of the overall Program Baseline
  • Serve as the technical interface with the customer.
  • Collect, manage, and report the program metrics and Technical Performance Measures (TPMs).
  • Manage risk and opportunity and the production of core engineering work products and track the work products and associated program dependencies in the program schedule.
  • Oversee the establishment and execution of the program lifecycle and work products.
  • Coordinate between the technical leads, program manager, and customer to ensure the integrity and executability of the program technical baseline.
  • Act as primary technical working group lead and interface with external parties; managing contractor giver-receivers, track actions, and manage technical team interactions.

Basic Qualifications

  • Must have an active U.S. Government DoD Top Secret security clearance at time of application, current and within scope, with the ability to obtain and maintain SCI approval/access.
  • Bachelor’s degree with 12 years of experience, a Master\'s degree with 10 years of experience or a PhD with 7 years of experience in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Applied Physics, Applied Mathematics, or related technical fields.
  • Experience leading technical teams.
  • Experience in systems development, integration, and test.
  • Demonstrated Multi-Disciplinary Engineering exposure (Software, Hardware, Electrical) and strong ability to communicate cross-functionally.
  • Demonstrated strong communication skills.
  • Ability to work 100% on-site full-time in Linthicum, MD

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master\'s degree or Ph.D. in STEM or technical management.
  • Risk and Opportunity Management experience.
  • Experience with Earned Value Management (EVMS)
  • Experience with Space sensor payloads, including antennas, radar, EO/IR, and/or communications.
  • Experience interfacing with large multi-site/multi-division teams.
  • Update as appropriate for band level of requisition

Primary Level Salary Range: $157,500.00 - $236,300.00

The above salary range represents a general guideline; however, Northrop Grumman considers a number of factors when determining base salary offers such as the scope and responsibilities of the position and the candidate\'s experience, education, skills and current market conditions. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay. Annual bonuses are designed to reward individual contributions as well as allow employees to share in company results.   • Collaborative profile, with the ability to work across networks and multiple stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with digital products and squad-based environments.

Differentials

  • Experience with CX frameworks (NPS, PR, Effort, First Contact Resolution).

title: Security Risk Management Specialist
description:
Overview

In security risk management we're looking to harness the power of industry best practice combined with driving new innovation on how we do security risk assessments and modelling. Our security risk management team is the primary owner of the strategy and practices of how we identify, track and reduce our security risk across everything we do. To support this we need to use industry best practices paired with emerging threat information to promote risk identification, quantification, impact analysis, and modelling to ultimately drive decision making. In this role, you will help establish and execute a broad strategic vision for the security risk program at Canonical. You will not only work within the team but also cross-functionally with various teams across the organisation. The team contributes ideas and requirements for Canonical product security, improving the resilience and robustness of all Ubuntu customers and users subject to cyber attacks. Additionally, the team collaborates with our Organisational Learning and Development team to develop playbooks and facilitate security training across Canonical. The security risk management team's mission is not only to secure Canonical, but also to contribute to the security of the wider open source ecosystem. They might share knowledge through public presentations and industry events, and share threat intelligence with the wider community or represent Canonical in sector-specific governance bodies.

What you will do in this role

  • Define Canonical's security risk management standards and playbooks
  • Analyse and improve Canonical's security risk practices
  • Evaluate, select and implement new security requirements, tools and practices
  • Grow the presence and thought leadership of Canonical security risk management practice
  • Develop Canonical security risk learning and development materials
  • Work with Security leadership to present information and influence change
  • Participate in developing key risk indicators, provide inputs to the development of key control indicators, and key performance indicators for various programs
  • Apply statistical models to risk frameworks (such as FAIR, sensitivity analysis, and others)
  • Participate in risk management, decision-making, and collaborative discussions
  • Lead quantified risk assessments and understand the value of qualitative data for improvements to quality and engineering processes
  • Interpret internal or external cyber security risk analyses in business terms and recommend a responsible course of action
  • Develop templates and materials to help with self-service risk management actions
  • Monitor and identify opportunities to improve the effectiveness of risk management processes
  • Launch campaigns to perform security assessments and help mitigate security risks across the company
  • Build evaluation methods and performance indicators to measure efficiency of security functions and capabilities.

What we are looking for

  • An exceptional academic track record
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Deep personal motivation to be at the forefront of technology security
  • Leadership and management ability
  • Excellent business English writing and presentation skills
  • Problem-solver with excellent communication skills, a deep technical understanding of security assessments and risk management
  • Expertise in threat modelling and risk management frameworks
  • Broad knowledge of how to operationalize the management of security risk
  • Experience in Secure Development Lifecycle and Security by Design methodology

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

Responsibilities

  • Define Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and Service Level Indicators (SLIs) to establish reliability standards and monitor system health
  • Architect resilient production systems using methodologies like canary deployments, shadow traffic, and testing-in-production

  • Ensure the platform’s infrastructure supports high availability and scalability in partnership with architecture and DevOps teams
  • Drive continuous improvement by identifying opportunities for process innovation and optimization

Requirements

  • 10+ years of professional experience in SRE, DevOps, or related areas, including managing production systems
  • Expertise in SRE practices such as SLOs, SLIs, canary testing, and incident management
  • Proficiency with cloud technologies like AWS, Google Cloud Platform, or Azure, with hands-on experience in multi-cloud setups

Nice to have

  • Design user journeys, personas, and sitemaps that bring clarity and intention to navigation and structure.
  • Apply responsive and accessible design principles to ensure seamless experiences across all devices and audiences.
  • Collaborate with developers to ensure design intent is maintained in final implementation—no coding is required.
  • Use design analytics tools (e.g., Hotjar, Google Analytics) to evaluate user engagement and optimize visual UX outcomes.
  • Stay current with design trends, emerging tools, and UX best practices to continuously elevate digital design standards.

Web Design Responsibilities

  • Design aesthetically refined, responsive websites and digital experiences that reflect brand identity and drive user engagement.
  • Craft visually dynamic layouts, landing pages, and UI components with a focus on clarity, hierarchy, and storytelling.
  • Work closely with marketing, e-commerce, and content teams to align design with strategic goals, user needs, and brand tone.
  • Develop and maintain design systems, component libraries, and brand style guides to ensure consistency and scalability across all touchpoints.
  • Design complementary digital assets such as banners, email templates, promotional graphics, and pop-ups that support campaign objectives.
  • Provide design QA during handoff and development phases to uphold visual quality and ensure design consistency.

Organizational & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Contribute to a creative and collaborative team environment by participating in critiques, brainstorming sessions, and cross-functional initiatives.

  • Maintain organized, well-labeled design files and ensure work is version-controlled and accessible across shared platforms.

What We’re Looking For

Education

  • 3 - 5 years of experience in UX and visual design with a strong portfolio showcasing modern, clean, and user-focused work across web, mobile, and email.
  • Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign), Figma, and Mac-based design workflows.
  • Expertise in user experience design principles, user interface best practices, and visual storytelling across digital platforms.
  • Familiarity with email marketing platforms (e.g., Klaviyo) and design standards for high-performance email campaigns.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present design concepts and rationale to diverse stakeholders.
  • Collaborative spirit, visual creativity, and a passion for delivering design that delights users and drives results.

Why Join High Tide

  • Be part of one of the largest global cannabis and accessories companies.
  • Join a collaborative team that values speed, ownership, and creativity.
  • Fully remote role with flexibility and meaningful impact.

How To Apply

To apply, please submit:

Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring a Business Services Team Manager to lead efficient and effective travel, logistics, event, scheduling, expense policy and administration.
This executive role requires outstanding coordination, planning, decision-making, budgeting, procurement, reporting and management. It is a fast-paced and complex operation in the tech industry.
We coordinate large-scale company events which involve travel for hundreds of people from 80+ countries. We run such events four times a year, a significant investment in our ability to shape culture, teamwork, execution plans and strategy. Our team is responsible for travel procurement and logistics, ensuring that these events run efficiently and safely. Visas, travel complications and unexpected situations make this a complex operation to run efficiently, demanding a rigorous approach and high work ethic in the team.
This team also serves as an independent check on expense claim approval, ensuring fairness and consistency across teams and countries. This requires integrity, transparency and accountability, and a willingness to set and politely defend the same expectations of the most senior and most junior colleagues.
Together these responsibilities amount to tens of millions in operational costs and a significant number of tactical and operational decisions.
Our team also provides traditional 'EA' services for company leads, though they do this across departments and as a consistent service rather than as personal assistants; they set and deliver to expectations on specific kinds of work. They schedule meetings, coordinate monthly reports, handle delegated approvals for travel and expenses, work across teams, coordinate with suppliers, and run small projects or initiatives.

description:
Job description

Estamos buscando uma pessoa Coordenadora de operações para o Time Vetta!

Você fará parte de uma equipe de desenvolvimento de produtos de software com foco em Energia & Sustentabilidade com cultura ágil e focada em entregas de valor com foco no cliente, principalmente dos segmentos de siderurgia e metalurgia. Se você tem experiência em gestão de pessoas, otimizar processos e garantir a eficiência na entrega de soluções inovadoras, esta oportunidade é para você. Nosso objetivo é construir produtos que transformam o setor de energia, promovendo um futuro mais sustentável.

VOCÊ JÁ CONHECE A VETTA?

Na Vetta, acreditamos que a tecnologia e a inovação são essenciais para criar um futuro mais sustentável e eficiente para todos. Como uma empresa líder em digitalização industrial, nossas soluções estão ajudando clientes em todo o mundo a reduzir o consumo de energia, a melhorar a eficiência operacional e apoiar a transição energética através da descarbonização.

Ao se juntar à nossa equipe, você terá a oportunidade de trabalhar em projetos emocionantes e desafiadores com alguns dos maiores especialistas da indústria . Além disso, você fará parte de uma equipe dedicada em gerar um impacto positivo no mundo e em ajudar nossos clientes a alcançar seus objetivos de negócios.O Time Vetta sabe a importância do trabalho em equipe e da colaboração para alcançar resultados que atingem todo o globo – ao mesmo tempo que a carreira de cada um é transformada.

Se você quer compartilhar a sua perspectiva para um mundo mais sustentável, venha ser parte do Time Vetta!


Main responsibilities

Nesse time, você terá a oportunidade de:

  • Gestão de Equipe: Liderar e motivar a equipe de desenvolvimento de software, garantindo que os produtos sejam entregues no prazo e com a qualidade esperada.
  • Otimização de Processos: Definir e implementar processos eficientes para o ciclo de vida do desenvolvimento de software, desde a concepção até a implantação e manutenção.
  • Coordenação Interdepartamental: Atuar como ponte entre as equipes de desenvolvimento, produto, design, marketing e vendas, assegurando que todos estejam alinhados com os objetivos do negócio.
  • Métricas e Análise: Estabelecer e monitorar KPIs (Key Performance Indicators) para avaliar a performance da equipe e a eficiência dos processos.
  • Gestão de Recursos: Planejar e alocar recursos (humanos e financeiros) de forma estratégica para maximizar a produtividade e a entrega de valor.
  • Garantia de Qualidade: Supervisionar a implementação de práticas de QA (Quality Assurance) para garantir a robustez, segurança e confiabilidade dos produtos.
  • Formação de Equipe de Alto Desempenho: Desenvolver e implementar programas de treinamento e mentoria para a equipe, garantindo a evolução contínua das competências e a formação de um time de alta performance. Além de liderar o processo de onboarding de novos colaboradores.
  • Padronização de Processos: Definir e garantir a padronização de práticas e metodologias de desenvolvimento entre as diversas equipes de produto, promovendo a consistência e a eficiência.
  • Inovação: Manter-se atualizado(a) com as tendências do mercado, identificando oportunidades de melhoria da eficiência do processo de desenvolvimento de software e produto.

Requirements and skills

O que esperamos de você para essa vaga:

  • Experiência comprovada como Coordenador(a) ou Gerente de Operações, ou em papel similar, em equipes de desenvolvimento de software;
  • Forte conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, etc.);
  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de projetos (utilizamos Azure DevOps);
  • Conhecimento para formação de equipes de alto desempenho utilizando recursos como IA, automação, etc;
  • Habilidade em liderança, comunicação e resolução de problemas;
  • Conhecimento técnico sobre o ciclo de vida de desenvolvimento de software;
  • Paixão pelo setor de Energia & Sustentabilidade e interesse em tecnologias para energias renováveis, eficiência energética, e smart grids.

O que será um diferencial:

  • Conhecimento prévio no setor de energia ou sustentabilidade;
  • Certificações em gestão de projetos (PMP, CSM, etc.);
  • Experiência com DevOps e automação.

Additional information

NOSSOS BENEFÍCIOS:

Sendo uma empresa voltada para pessoas, buscamos sempre valorizar a nossa equipe. Ao entrar para o Time Vetta, oferecemos:

  • Cartão Flash comvale-alimentação/refeição deR$ 32,00 por dia , aceito em diversos estabelecimentos para você usar como preferir.
  • Auxílio home office deR$ 100,00/mês eflexibilidade no horário de trabalho.
  • Se você trabalhar no escritório da Vetta, em Belo Horizonte, teráVale-Transporte .
  • Pensando na sua saúde e bem-estar, oferecemosPlano de Saúde SulAmérica ePlano Odontológico Bradesco ,com a possibilidade de inclusão dos seus dependentes.
  • WellHub, TotalPass e UniCamente , para você cuidar da sua saúde integralmente, com acesso a atividades físicas e a profissionais de diversas áreas da saúde.
  • Clube de Descontos e Recompensas , com descontos em diversas redes de produtos e de serviços.
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida, para os pais e mães viverem essa fase com tranquilidade.
  • PLR - conforme tabela do sindicato.

E TEM MAIS...

  • Day-Off de Aniversário.
  • No Dress Code. Vista-se com o que te deixa confortável!
  • Programa de Incentivo à Formação Contínua e Capacitação , para que você possa continuar aprendendo e compartilhando experiências.

A empresa é contratante é líder global em soluções de marketing promocional e programas de fidelização, colaborando com grandes marcas para criar campanhas que fortalecem a conexão entre empresas e consumidores. Com presença internacional e uma cultura voltada para resultados, a empresa valoriza profissionais empreendedores, orientados para o sucesso e apaixonados por vendas consultivas.
Descrição da Posição
O Executivo de Vendas será responsável por conduzir todo o ciclo de vendas B2B, desde a prospecção até o fechamento de contratos, com foco em empresas de grande porte nos setores de varejo e bens de consumo (FMCG). A posição tem como objetivo principal expandir a presença da empresa no mercado brasileiro, desenvolvendo relacionamentos estratégicos de longo prazo e oferecendo soluções personalizadas de marketing promocional e fidelização. O profissional atuará de forma consultiva, identificando necessidades específicas dos clientes, propondo estratégias que agreguem valor aos negócios e conduzindo negociações de grandes volumes, mantendo a empresa competitiva frente à concorrência.
Principais Responsabilidades

  • Identificar e prospectar novas oportunidades de negócios com empresas brasileiras de médio e grande porte, utilizando abordagens estratégicas e personalizadas.
  • Qualificar leads por meio de análises detalhadas das necessidades do cliente, garantindo alinhamento com as soluções oferecidas pela empresa.
  • Desenvolver e apresentar propostas comerciais personalizadas, destacando o valor das soluções de marketing promocional e programas de fidelidade.
  • Conduzir reuniões com tomadores de decisão de grandes marcas, utilizando técnicas de vendas consultivas para construir confiança e credibilidade.
  • Negociar contratos de grandes volumes, estruturando acordos que atendam às expectativas do cliente e os objetivos estratégicos da empresa, garantindo margens adequadas e condições comerciais sustentáveis.
  • Conduzir o fechamento de vendas de alto valor, assegurando a formalização de contratos e a entrega de soluções alinhadas às necessidades do cliente.
  • Gerenciar o pipeline de vendas, monitorando o progresso das oportunidades e reportando resultados à matriz internacional por meio de relatórios detalhados.
  • Monitorar as estratégias e ações da concorrência no mercado brasileiro, identificando oportunidades para diferenciar as soluções da empresa e se destacar no setor.
  • Desenvolver estratégias para posicionar a empresa de forma competitiva, destacando os diferenciais das soluções oferecidas em relação aos concorrentes.
  • Manter relacionamentos de longo prazo com clientes, atuando como ponto de contato principal e garantindo a satisfação contínua.
  • Acompanhar tendências do mercado brasileiro de varejo e FMCG, identificando oportunidades para posicionar as soluções da PPI de forma competitiva.

  • Experiência mínima de 5 anos em vendas B2B, com histórico comprovado de resultados em negociações complexas e fechamento de contratos de grandes volumes.

description:
About Acadia Pharmaceuticals

About Acadia Pharmaceuticals Acadia is advancing breakthroughs in neuroscience to elevate life. Since our founding, we have been working at the forefront of healthcare to bring vital solutions to people who need them most. We developed and commercialized the first and only FDA-approved drug to treat hallucinations and delusions associated with Parkinson's disease psychosis, and the first and only approved drug in the United States and Canada for the treatment of Rett syndrome. Our clinical-stage development efforts are focused on Prader-Willi syndrome, Alzheimer's disease psychosis, and multiple other programs targeting neuro-psychiatric and neuro-rare diseases. For more information, visit Acadia.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Seeking talent near: Houston, TX; Pasadena, TX; Baytown, TX

Position Summary

The Neuroscience Sales Specialist is responsible for achieving sales goals within the assigned territory by building strong customer relationships, delivering compliant and compelling product education, and driving appropriate patient access. This role requires expertise in neuroscience, deep knowledge of the local healthcare landscape, and the ability to partner effectively with healthcare professionals (HCPs) and key stakeholders to deliver meaningful value and service.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Promote Acadia products to HCPs in person and virtually, providing clinical, disease state, and reimbursement information in a compliant and customer-focused manner.
  • Develop and execute a territory business plan to meet or exceed sales objectives, leveraging market data, customer insights, and quarterly action plans.
  • Establish and maintain strong relationships with HCPs, including key opinion leaders, advocacy organizations, and other healthcare stakeholders.
  • Address customer questions, concerns, and objections using advanced dialogue and selling skills.
  • Tailor approved sales aids, clinical reprints, and brand resources to meet specific customer needs.
  • Partner with internal colleagues (e.g., managed markets, operations, sales training, marketing) to deliver coordinated solutions.
  • Provide guidance on product pricing, reimbursement, and specialty distribution channels, acting as a liaison between customers and the Company for access-related issues.
  • Accurately track and report sales activities, business expenses, and customer interactions in a timely manner.
  • Represent Acadia at conferences, exhibits, and trainings; participate in national, regional, and local meetings as required.
  • Mentor and train new sales specialists as needed, and contribute to cross-functional projects and field strategic insights.

Knowledge & Expertise

  • Deep understanding of neuroscience disease states, Acadia products, and local/regional market dynamics.
  • Ability to serve as a trusted resource in the medical community.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and virtual engagement platforms (e.g., Zoom, WebEx).
  • Strong grasp of payer dynamics, including Part D and specialty pharmacy/hub distribution.

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelors degree required; life sciences preferred.
  • Experience:
    • Sales Specialist : Minimum 1+ years of sales experience in pharmaceutical/healthcare; neuroscience preferred.
    • Senior Specialist : Minimum 5+ years of healthcare sales (2+ in complex/account-based selling).
  • Demonstrated advanced selling skills, leadership abilities, and business acumen.
  • Proven success in influencing diverse HCP audiences across multiple care settings.
  • Strong interpersonal, communication, and negotiation skills.
  • Ability to work independently, adapt to change, and deliver consistently high results.
  • Must reside within the territory (or within 30 miles of its border) and possess a valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record.
  • Ability to meet travel requirements, including significant driving and overnight stays; air travel as needed.

They have a pipeline of product candidates in development for the treatment of haematological malignancies and solid tumours.

The Senior Manager - Tissue Operations is accountable for managing onboarding and on-going performance of Apheresis and Treatment Centres used for Clinical Chimeric Antigen Receptor (CAR) T-cell Therapies. Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring an Alliances Field Engineer to help our biggest partners (companies like Intel, Nvidia, Google, Dell, HP, Accenture, Tata and the like) understand and embrace our open source platform for themselves and their customers.
Our worldwide field engineering team apply expert insights to real-world customer problems, enabling the enterprise adoption of Ubuntu, OpenStack, Kubernetes, AI/MLOps and a wide range of associated technologies. We are experts in the whole open source stack, from kernel to desktop, from cloud to the edge. Our team is also interested in business problems - building things reliably, efficiently and cost-effectively, and we have to learn to speak the language of our customers and their industries.
We help global companies embrace public and private cloud infrastructure, cloud native operations, and open source applications. For this team we are looking for several Alliances Engineers to support OEM (hardware manufacturers), GSI (global system integrators), ISV (independent software vendors), Channel partners and Public Cloud alliance partners. You will support various alliances and partners of Canonical to adopt our products and technologies, help business leaders to define joint go-to-market programs with partners from the technical standpoint.
We often say that our field engineers have 'the hardest job at Canonical' because customers can ask about any aspect of our solutions and products and expect a thoughtful, well-informed answer. We always want to do the best thing for our partners and customers, regardless of our company interests, and field engineers are the people we trust to ensure that is true.
Location : This is a home-based role, we are hiring worldwide.
What your day will look like

  • Understand Ubuntu, Linux, networking and services in real-world environments
  • Architect cloud infrastructure solutions like Kubernetes, Kubeflow, OpenStack, Ceph, and Spark either On-Premises or in Public Cloud (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)
  • Architect and integrate popular open source software such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Kafka, Cassandra and NGINX
  • Help partners to offer and architect joint solutions utilizing Canonical's technologies on top of the public clouds and in the data center
  • Design and publish joint Reference Architectures and perform technical validations with various partners
  • Prepare and run onboarding sessions/workshops with various partners' teams to promote Canonical products and solutions
If you have a passion for the latest open source technologies, cloud-native development, data center technologies such as Kubernetes and computer networking, you will love the Alliances Engineer role at Canonical.
What we are looking for in you
  • Extensive experience with Linux (Ubuntu preferred), Kubernetes, Ceph, software automation
  • Experience designing and implementing solutions on top of public or private clouds
  • Python and bash understanding, troubleshooting skills
  • Fluent written and spoken English
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • High motivation, ability to multi-task and follow-up reliably on commitments
  • Interest in customer-facing engagement, including pitching, demonstrating and understanding customer environment and needs
  • Interest in new technologies like LXD, Juju and Snaps
  • Ability to travel globally up to 30% of the time

What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we've been working remotely since 2004!

  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme

  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.
Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.

Description
gener8tor is seeking a Lightning Rounds Coordinator to support their Lightning Rounds (startup and investor matchmaking) events. This position will support the Director of Lightning Rounds to ensure multiple successful events per year.
We are initially posting this role as an independent contractor position. We're flexible and happy to explore the arrangement that works best based on your location, preferences, and our mutual goals.
Company
gener8tor runs accelerators and venture capital funds to catalyze community, mentorship, network, conviction and capital to bridge a community's genius with opportunity. The gener8tor platform includes pre-accelerators, accelerators, corporate programming, conferences and fellowships. gener8tor operates venture capital funds and startup accelerators across 45 cities, 25 states and 3 countries, working with more than 300 startups per year. To date, gener8tor has worked with more than 1,500 startups that have cumulatively gone on to raise more than $2B in follow-on capital and employ more than 11,000 people
At gener8tor we…

  • See genius in every community. We believe the company has a chance to accomplish a generational challenge in bridging genius with opportunity.
  • Never self-defeat and have a "play to win" mentality. We revolve everything we do around helping the entrepreneurs in our programs.
  • Are curious. We work hard to find hidden gems others overlook.
  • Believe no job is beneath us. We wipe down the tables and load up the U-Hauls with enthusiasm. Work as a team to get $#!^ done!
  • Strive for "that guy emailed me." Based on a story from our founders, we share a commitment to take a bottom-up approach to building strong, personal, 1-1 relationships. We believe that the best way to quality is through quantity.
Our values are core to how we work . If they don't resonate with you, this role might not be the right fit.
Responsibilities
This is an independent contractor position. As such, the ideal candidate will be a self-directed professional capable of managing their own time, tools, and methods to deliver agreed-upon outcomes. We expect you to bring your own best practices and operate with a high degree of autonomy while aligning with project timelines and the following key performance goals.
  • Recruitment and Matchmaking
    • Proactively source, filter, and send one-on-one emails to hundreds of high quality startups and investors per Lightning Rounds event, ensuring a strong pool of high-quality participants.
    • Drive startup and investor signups to consistently meet or exceed matchmaking targets, ensuring investor meeting slots are fully and effectively utilized.
    • Review startup profiles and investor theses to design curated matches that maximize the quality and relevance of event meetings.
  • Logistics and Communications
    • Manage the logistics of each Lightning Rounds event, including backend Airtable configuration, communications with startups and investors, coordination with gener8tor staff to run the event.
    • Provide lead-up and day-of support to deliver smooth event execution and an excellent experience for both startups and investors.
    • Serve as the primary point of contact for the inbox, ensuring timely, clear, and professional communication with participants. Lead email Q&A with startups and investors as they need support leading up to the event.
  • Support and Collaboration
    • Support the Director of Lightning Rounds on outreach and logistical efforts and progress.
    • Support gener8tor teammates across multiple programs, including gBETA, Investment Accelerator, Skills, etc.

  • Proficiency with or ability to quickly learn Airtable.
