title: Junior Linux Kernel Engineer - Ubuntu
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Junior Linux Kernel Engineer - Ubuntu role at Canonical .

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

Every year we select new junior professionals into the Canonical Kernel Team, to work on the Linux kernel for Ubuntu. If you've enjoyed operating systems in your coursework or current role, you are confident in your ability to write high quality C and possibly Rust, and are ready to take the plunge and see how it all works, then this would be a great place to pursue your next career stage. We are a global team working to ship the world's most widely used Linux kernel, across the very latest silicon and cloud, where you can apply and grow your software engineering skills.

The Canonical Kernel Team builds and maintains all supported Ubuntu Linux kernels for a variety of platforms and architectures from small embedded devices to standard desktop/server systems to large-scale cloud environments. In your first year you will tackle serious initiatives, which include but are not limited to:

  • Optimized solutions for key Silicon and Cloud partner platforms
  • Developer platforms such as Raspberry Pi and RISC-V
  • Enabling Ubuntu on a wide range of embedded systems
  • Security hardening and exploit mitigation
  • Third-party driver integration and distribution, such as graphics
  • Expanded driver support for bleeding-edge PC platforms

We select candidates that are recent university graduates or early career professionals who are enthusiastic to develop kernel-level software in multiple areas including security updates, patching, and testing. The successful candidate will have a background in software engineering, be motivated to work in a distributed team and willing and able to travel globally twice a year for company engineering events.

These are full-time positions available to prospective or recently graduated students.

Location: We have home-based Kernel Teams in every timezone.

The role entails

  • Collaborate regularly and proactively with a globally distributed team
  • Learn from senior mentors to demystify the inner workings of the Linux kernel and how it is distributed
  • Work closely with external silicon, cloud, or hardware manufacturer delivery teams on bleeding-edge platforms
  • Diagnose and resolve issues in the kernel reported by customers, the community, and discovered by your own rigorous testing
  • Take personal responsibility for the delivery of various flavors of the Ubuntu Linux kernel
  • Improve tooling and automation for delivery and test of Ubuntu Linux kernels
  • Submit, review, and apply kernel patches, working with both internal and external upstream maintainers

What we are looking for in you

  • Well-organized and motivated self-starter able to thrive in a remote work environment
  • Professional manner with colleagues, business partners, and the open-source community
  • Ability to communicate effectively in English, both written and verbal
  • Programming experience in C and/or Rust
  • Familiarity with version control practices, ideally with git
  • Understanding of operating system kernel fundamentals
  • Ability to travel twice a year for company events of up to two weeks length

Nice-to-have skills

  • Interest and experience in Rust
  • Python and Bash scripting ability
  • Prior experience with Ubuntu/Debian/Snap packaging
  • Demonstrated experience with kernel patching and debugging
  • Strong grasp of device drivers, BSP's, and other low level system engineering

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

How We Work

Benefits

description:
O isaac é a maior plataforma de soluções financeiras feita para escolas. Impulsionamos as instituições oferecendo receita garantida e proporcionando mais flexibilidade de pagamento para as famílias.

Nosso objetivo é facilitar a gestão financeira, acabando com a dor de cabeça e permitindo que a escola consiga focar na missão de educar , dedicando mais tempo e recursos para tirar os planos do papel.

Nos últimos 4 anos, já ajudamos mais de2.000 escolas, garantimos mais de R$5bi em mensalidades garantidas, e ajudamos a aumentar em 9% o número de matrículas em nossas escolas parceiras.

A cultura do isaac incentiva a autonomia, a mão na massa, o trabalho em equipe e o uso de dados para construir soluções inovadoras.

Temos muito para construir e transformar na Educação brasileira, e você pode fazer parte dessa revolução, vivenciando o impacto do seu trabalho na sociedade!

Vem com a gente?

No isaac, operamos com um time enxuto de Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) que lidera nossa estratégia de Platform Engineering , priorizando a autonomia das equipes de desenvolvimento. Estamos focados em alavancar a produtividade das pessoas e a resiliência dos serviços, apoiando dezenas de pessoas desenvolvedoras, engenheiras de dados e cientistas de dados.

O time de SRE é fundamental para nosso sucesso. Para fortalecer nosso time, estamos em busca de uma pessoa SRE Tech Lead com expertise em automação de processos de infraestrutura e engenharia, com foco em Platform Engineering e Developer Experience.

No isaac, você terá a oportunidade de:

  • Fazer a diferença real: Você terá um impacto direto na produtividade e na autonomia das equipes de desenvolvimento, ajudando-as a criar e manter produtos e serviços excepcionais.
  • Trabalhar com tecnologias de ponta: Você terá a oportunidade de trabalhar com as mais recentes tecnologias em nuvem, como Kubernetes, GCP, Helm, Datadog, Terraform, Humanitec e Cast AI
  • Aprender e crescer: Você estará em um ambiente de aprendizado contínuo, cercado por pessoas talentosas e apaixonadas pelo que fazem.
  • Fazer parte de uma equipe incrível: Você se juntará a uma equipe pequena, mas de alto desempenho, de SREs experientes e apaixonados pelo seu trabalho.

No dia a dia você irá:

  • Liderar iniciativas técnicas do time de SRE
  • Criar abstrações e prover serviços de infraestrutura em nuvem que ajudem os times a reduzir a carga cognitiva e a fricção na criação e manutenção de produtos e serviços, aumentando sua autonomia e diminuindo o toil.
  • Avançar nossa plataforma Cloud com Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) usando Terraform e Kubernetes como base.
  • Gerenciar e otimizar os componentes usados pelas equipes em seus pipelines de Continuous Integration.
  • Administrar clusters Kubernetes rodando em GKE.
  • Colaborar com os times de desenvolvimento para definir a arquitetura por meio de RFCs.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com as equipes de engenharia para desenvolver soluções em conjunto.
  • Diagnosticar problemas de arquitetura e em serviços mantidos pela equipe de SRE.
  • Contribuir na definição de estratégias de monitoramento e observabilidade dos sistemas, SLIs e SLOs.
  • Gerenciar incidentes de infraestrutura e prestar suporte às equipes de engenharia durante incidentes em suas aplicações.

Para participar do nosso processo você precisa ter:

  • Experiência consolidada como SRE, DevOps, Production Engineer ou Platform Engineer.
  • Proficiência em tecnologias de nuvem, preferencialmente GCP.
  • Experiência sólida em Terraform.
  • Ampla experiência em Kubernetes (GKE é um diferencial).
  • Habilidade em pelo menos uma linguagem de programação (preferencialmente Go ou Python).
  • Conhecimento sólido em redes e protocolos, armazenamento, computação e CDN.
  • Compreensão dos princípios de segurança de aplicações e ambientes em nuvem.
  • Experiência em observabilidade.
  • Experiência em administração de sistemas Linux e bancos de dados (PostgreSQL e Redis).
  • Experiência em criação de pipelines de Integração Contínua/Integração Contínua e Entrega Contínua (CI/CD).
  • Experiência em monitoramento, observabilidade e registro de infraestrutura e serviços (Conhecimento de Datadog é um diferencial).
  • Auxílio alimentação e/ou refeição (Flash flexível - R$40,50/dia);
  • Auxílio home office no primeiro mês de trabalho (R$200,00);
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico Sulamérica sem mensalidade e com coparticipação;
  • Licença maternidade (180 dias) e paternidade (30 dias) estendida;
  • Auxílio creche para mamães e papais com filhos até 06 anos;
  • Cuidado com a saúde física para você e seus dependentes: parceria com a Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Incentivo à educação - parcerias com diversas instituições de ensino;
  • ArcoLab - plataforma de educação corporativa;
  • Desconto em passagens aéreas e hospedagens;
  • Reembolso para evolução profissonal (cursos, palestras, eventos, etc);

title: Direct Response Copywriter
description:
Overview

Pure is looking for a Direct Response Copywriter to join our team! As our creative head, you will be responsible for the ideation, scripting, planning, and managing of the entire creative process with a big focus on UGC ads and psychology-based creatives to be used across paid marketing channels.

We are looking to hire someone with 3+ years of work experience. The ideal candidate has prior experience in creating paid advertisements specifically for Meta Platforms, UGC, direct response marketing & bonus points if experience with influencer / UGC partnerships.

Who are we?

At Pure, we are dedicated to transforming lives by creating high-quality supplements backed by science and trusted by our growing community. Our mission is to make achieving better health simpler, more effective, and more accessible for everyone. Since our launch, we’ve scaled rapidly through viral digital marketing and built a passionate customer base that loves and trusts our products. We operate with a small but mighty team that thrives on innovation, data-driven growth, and relentless creativity—and we’re excited to bring on a Creative Strategist to play a pivotal role in scaling our brand even further.

What is our culture like & who is a good fit?

Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We utilize creativity to do more with less - and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by the following three core values : "work smart", "overdeliver", "speed is king" and "better everyday". We love learning - every problem is an opportunity to grow. If you want a stress-free corporate 9-5 job, this isn't it.

If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founders- and play a huge role in scaling it to $12M+ a year. Drive results with a group of passionate, smart & hardworking fun people. Work in an environment without politics, or corporate chicanery. Play a big part in our growth being hands on, active, and doing what is necessary with an excellent bonus plan based on performance then you have come to the right place.

Key Objectives

  • Manage the full creative process (from scripting all the way to final creative) in order to produce high converting creatives on an ongoing basis.
  • Work with our content manager to find, manage and source new content to be used across all marketing channels
  • Drive measurable improvements in core advertising metrics across digital channels with improved creatives.
  • Script UGC Direct response creatives
  • Use data from creative performance on Meta to dissect, analyze and improve upon our creatives to continuously improve performance across our creatives.
  • Work with our marketing team to come up with new creative concepts and ideas.
  • Conduct strategic customer and competitor research to better optimize creative efforts
  • Provide creative reports on a monthly and quarterly basis
  • Decide on the next steps needed to scale Meta Ads further through better creative

Qualifications

  • Fully remote
  • Fluent in English
  • Direct Response Expertise: 3+ Years Experience with performance creative for DTC brands or working at a creative agency is a must.
  • Tools & Metrics: Proficiency in performance analytics tools such as Triple Whale, Motion, pitch decks, and spreadsheets to present ideas and campaign outcomes effectively.
  • UGC Experience: Lots of experience with creating briefs for UGC creators to produce high converting content across paid channels.
  • Creative & Analytical Mindset: Ability to generate fresh ideas, write scripts, shot listing, and make data-driven decisions based on ad performance.
  • No issue working overtime or on the weekends if needed. You wouldn’t know what to do with your free time if you were working less. You are passionate about your work.
  • Excellent cultural fit as per our values above.
  • Are excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founders.
  • Basic psychology-based copywriting skills

Accountabilities

  • Brainstorm and pitch weekly ad ideas aligned with direct response principles.
  • Write 80-100 high-converting ad scripts per week for Meta Platforms
  • Come up with static ad ideas on a weekly basis
  • Analyze performance metrics to derive actionable insights for future campaigns.
  • Collaborate with editors and designers to ensure ads are visually compelling and on-brand.
  • Adapt ad strategies to capitalize on emerging internet trends and consumer behaviors.
  • Present performance analyses and creative strategies to the marketing team
  • Continuously refine ad concepts and troubleshoot underperforming campaigns to achieve maximum ROI.
  • Iterate on winning ads to create more winning assets to produce a better ROI.

How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate

When hiring, we’ll work with you to define the KPIs you’ll be responsible for and set targets. This removes ambiguity around wondering if you’re doing a good job after you start.

Initial soft interview, then a technical interview + test project with the current head of marketing, and a final interview to ensure culture fit. We plan to hire within ~8 - 10 days of conducting these interviews. We pride ourselves on timely responses and updates for applicants.

For this specific role, we will walk you through the long-term vision and opportunities that have us excited about this business - and how you fit in. We will show you our current structure and where we are headed!

Salary Expectation

USD $36,000 USD to $70,000 USD per year + Performance Bonus Structure based on experience and expertise.

Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
Every year we select new junior professionals into the Canonical Kernel Team, to work on the Linux kernel for Ubuntu. If you've enjoyed operating systems in your coursework or current role, you are confident in your ability to write high quality C and possibly Rust, and are ready to take the plunge and see how it all works, then this would be a great place to pursue your next career stage. We are a global team working to ship the world's most widely used Linux kernel, across the very latest silicon and cloud, where you can apply and grow your software engineering skills.
The Canonical Kernel Team builds and maintains all supported Ubuntu Linux kernels for a variety of platforms and architectures from small embedded devices to standard desktop/server systems to large-scale cloud environments. In your first year you will tackle serious initiatives, which include but are not limited to:

  • Optimized solutions for key Silicon and Cloud partner platforms
  • Developer platforms such as Raspberry Pi and RISC-V
  • Enabling Ubuntu on a wide range of embedded systems
  • Security hardening and exploit mitigation
  • Third-party driver integration and distribution, such as graphics
  • Expanded driver support for bleeding-edge PC platforms
We select candidates that are recent university graduates or early career professionals who are enthusiastic to develop kernel-level software in multiple areas including security updates, patching, and testing. The successful candidate will have a background in software engineering, be motivated to work in a distributed team and willing and able to travel globally twice a year for company engineering events.
These are full-time positions available to prospective or recently graduated students.
Location: We have home-based Kernel Teams in every timezone.
The role entails
  • Collaborate regularly and proactively with a globally distributed team
  • Learn from senior mentors to demystify the inner workings of the Linux kernel and how it is distributed
  • Work closely with external silicon, cloud, or hardware manufacturer delivery teams on bleeding-edge platforms
  • Diagnose and resolve issues in the kernel reported by customers, the community, and discovered by your own rigorous testing
  • Take personal responsibility for the delivery of various flavors of the Ubuntu Linux kernel
  • Improve tooling and automation for delivery and test of Ubuntu Linux kernels
  • Submit, review, and apply kernel patches, working with both internal and external upstream maintainers
What we are looking for in you
  • Well-organized and motivated self-starter able to thrive in a remote work environment
  • Professional manner with colleagues, business partners, and the open-source community
  • Ability to communicate effectively in English, both written and verbal
  • Programming experience in C and/or Rust
  • Familiarity with version control practices, ideally with git
  • Understanding of operating system kernel fundamentals
  • Ability to travel twice a year for company events of up to two weeks length
Nice-to-have skills
  • Interest and experience in Rust
  • Python and Bash scripting ability
  • Prior experience with Ubuntu/Debian/Snap packaging
  • Demonstrated experience with kernel patching and debugging
  • Strong grasp of device drivers, BSP's, and other low level system engineering
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

caembrasil.com.br | instagram.com / caembrasil

Indivior is a global pharmaceutical company working to help change patients' lives by developing medicines to treat opioid use disorder (OUD). POSITION SUMMARY:

The Commercial Head, Accounts is a senior leadership role responsible for shaping and executing the national account strategy across key institutional and organized customer segments. This role leads a team of Account Directors and collaborates cross-functionally to drive access, growth, and long-term partnerships with addiction treatment centers, health systems, integrated delivery networks (IDNs), Veterans Affairs (VA), and other high-impact accounts.

Essential Functions

Strategic Leadership

  • Develop and implement a national commercial strategy aligned with corporate objectives and therapeutic priorities.
  • Lead the design and execution of account segmentation, targeting, and engagement models.
  • Serve as a strategic advisor to the SVP, Commercial on market dynamics, access trends, and customer insights.

Team Management

  • Direct and mentor a team of Account Directors.
  • Foster a high-performance culture focused on accountability, collaboration, and innovation.
  • Oversee recruitment, onboarding, and development of account team talent.

  • Cultivate executive-level relationships with key decision-makers across health systems, and coordinate with matrix partners to support efforts with payers and government entities.
  • Ensure consistent delivery of value-based solutions tailored to account needs.
  • Represent the company at industry forums, conferences, and strategic customer engagements.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Market Access, Medical Affairs, Marketing, Channel, and Compliance to ensure coordinated execution.
  • Align account strategies with field sales, reimbursement, and patient support services.

Performance & Analytics

  • Set and monitor KPIs for account performance, access milestones, and revenue growth.
  • Leverage data analytics to inform decision-making and optimize resource allocation.
  • Ensure compliance with all regulatory and ethical standards.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or advanced degree preferred.
  • 10+ years of progressive commercial/sales experience in the pharmaceutical or biotech industry as well as leadership experience.
  • Proven success in leading national account teams and driving access in complex healthcare environments.
  • Deep understanding of organized customer models, including IDNs, VA, and correctional health systems.
  • Strong business acumen, strategic thinking, and executive presence.

Competencies/Conduct

  • Strategic Thinking: Ability to develop long-term strategies that drive business success.
  • Leadership: Strong leadership skills to motivate and manage a diverse team.
  • Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to make data-driven decisions.
  • Customer Focus: Deep commitment to understanding and meeting customer needs.
  • Adaptability: Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage change effectively.
  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present ideas clearly and persuasively.

Benefits

Indivior is committed to providing a culture driven by guiding principles and top-tier benefits that match the importance of the work we do. The Indivior experience includes:

  • 3 weeks’ vacation plus floating holidays and sick leave, plus company closure from December 24th- January 1st
  • 401(k) and Profit Sharing Plan - Company match of 75% on your first 6% of contributions and profit sharing contribution equal to 4% of your eligible pay
  • U.S. Employee Stock Purchase Plan - 15% Discount
  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental, Vision, Life and Disability coverage
  • Health, Dependent Care and Limited Purpose Flex Spending and HSA options
  • Adoption assistance
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Concierge/personal assistance services
  • Voluntary benefits including Legal, Pet Insurance and Critical Illness coverage
  • Gym, fitness facility and cell phone discounts

Guiding Principles

Indivior’s guiding principles are the foundation for each employee’s success and growth. Each employee is expected to demonstrate understanding and adherence to our guiding principles in their everyday performance.

Compliance Obligations

Indivior is committed to maintaining a workplace where employees are committed to compliance and feel comfortable raising concerns about potential violations of policies or unethical behaviour. As part of your responsibilities, you are expected to:

  • Employee Obligations: Have unquestionable ethics and integrity with the willingness to stand firm on these principles even under significant pressure

  • Be part of a lean, fast-moving, execution-focused team

Clara is the fastest-growing company in Latin America. We've built the leading solution for companies to make and manage all their payments. We invite you to join us if you want to be part of a fast-paced environment that will accelerate your career and support you to do some of the best work of your life alongside a passionate and committed team distributed across the Americas.

We’re looking for an Account Executive to accelerate Clara’s growth by generating and closing new business opportunities through 100% outbound efforts. You’ll play a key role in expanding Clara’s reach in Brazil by identifying, engaging, and converting high-potential prospects.

This is a self-driven sales role where you’ll manage your own pipeline end to end—from prospecting to closing—while representing Clara with clarity, discipline, and energy. Success will be measured by your ability to hit and exceed aggressive new client acquisition targets.

  • Set and consistently exceed monthly and quarterly sales goals

  • Track and optimize performance against KPIs such as outreach volume, conversion rate, and closed deals

  • Maintain detailed records of all sales activity and client interactions using Hubspot CRM

  • Act as a brand ambassador, clearly communicating Clara’s value proposition to potential clients

Who you are
We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Must haves

  • Strong pipeline management skills and a consistent record of exceeding outbound sales targets

  • Excellent verbal and written communication and negotiation abilities

  • Self-motivated and comfortable working independently

  • Based in Manaus

  • Working proficiency in Portuguese

  • Intermediate proficiency in English (reading, writing, and verbal communication)

Nice to haves

  • Experience in SaaS or the financial industry

  • Network within the financial ecosystem

  • Basic proficiency in Spanish or a desire to learn

  • Experience or interest in using AI tools to automate workflows

  • A good sense of humor

Why join Clara

At Clara, you’ll have the autonomy, speed, and support to make meaningful impact — not just on your team, but on how organizations are run across Latin America.

Who we are

  • We’re the leading B2B fintech for spend management in Latin America.

  • Certified as one of the world's fastest-growing companies, a Great Place to Work , and a LinkedIn Top Startup .

  • Passionate about making Latin America more prosperous and competitive.

  • Constantly innovating to build financial infrastructure that enables each of our customers to thrive.

  • Product-led, high-talent-density culture — designed for builders who raise the bar.

  • Proud of our open, inclusive, and values-driven environment.

What we believe in

  • #Clarity. We say things clearly, directly, and proactively.

  • #Simplicity. We reduce noise to focus on what really matters.

  • #Ownership. We take responsibility and never wait to be told.

  • #Pride. We build products and experiences we’re proud of.

  • #Always Be Changing (ABC). We grow through feedback, risk-taking, and action.

  • #Inclusivity. Every voice counts. Everyone contributes to our mission.

What we offer

  • Competitive salary and stock options (ESOP ) from day one

  • Multicultural team with daily exposure to Portuguese, Spanish, and English (our corporate language)

  • Annual learning budget and internal accelerated development paths

  • High-ownership environment: we move fast, learn fast, and raise the bar — together

  • Smart, ambitious teammates — low ego, high impact

  • Flexible vacation and hybrid work model focused on results

If you’re ready for growth, ownership, and impact — apply now and help us redefine B2B finance in Latin America.

Clara’s Hybrid Policy

Claridians in a hybrid mode split their time between working from the office, talking to or visiting customers, or working from home. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for each individual and team.

We don't enforce a minimum number of days for most roles, but you're expected to spend time at the office organically, and be at the office most days during your ramp-up or when required by your leader.

  • Atuar como ponte de integração entre Brasil, Cone Sul e Cone Norte, garantindo consistência na narrativa e nas ações de PR e reputação.

  • Fluência em português e espanhol (inglês desejável).

title: Contracts Specialist
description:
About The Role

VentureWell is seeking a Contracts Specialist to join our dynamic team to support contracting processes across a variety of programs. Responsibilities include drafting, reviewing and administering various contract types (including Firm Fixed Price and Time & Materials) and modifications. VentureWell’s funding includes Federal contracting dollars, so Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) experience is highly preferred. You will work closely with internal Programs teams to meet contracting needs with attention to detail that supports program goals. A thorough understanding of contracting principles, strong analytical skills, and the ability to balance multiple tasks are required.

Responsibilities

Program Contracting Support (80-90% of time)

  • Develop, maintain, and catalog process documents and agreement templates for contracting paid for by Organizational, Foundational, Federal, and Routine funding, as assigned
  • Liaise between organizational and programmatic stakeholders for agreement and approval on scopes of work and terms and conditions
  • Field and process internal requests for contract support
  • Process, record, and store agreements and delivery orders for review and execution
  • Support pre-award/procurement activities (Requests for Proposals, Requests for Information, Requests for Qualifications)
  • Track, manage, and communicate with consultants and vendors for materials required to satisfy agreement compliance conditions
  • Onboard new consultants and vendors as approved and requested
  • Support other Contracting and Expense Team members with recording expenses and ad hoc requests
  • Facilitate and project manage programmatic stipends process and expense recording
  • Track and manage consultant and contractor commitments
  • Create and deliver routine and ad hoc reporting to internal stakeholders as assigned or requested
  • Research and problem solve using precedent and policies for contracting concerns and emergent programs

General & Administrative (10-20% of time)

  • Development of process or procedure documentation to enhance or improve contracting operations
  • Training and participation in group meetings and department projects or objectives

What You Bring

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Finance, or Accounting preferred; Experience considered in lieu of degree
  • A minimum of 3 years of work experience, with at least one year working with contracts or experience working directly with VentureWell programs
  • Current or prior experience working in a full-time contracting capacity required
  • High degree of digital fluency using cloud-based office tools (G Suite, CRMs, team collaboration tools, and other web-based applications); ability to incorporate these tools into day-to-day work; specific experience with financial/accounting software (NetSuite or similar fund accounting software preferred)
  • Ability to succeed in an environment with competing and changing priorities and tight deadlines
  • Track record of building solid, collaborative working relationships; strong team player who is highly responsive and customer-service oriented
  • Self-starter with strong attention to detail and a commitment to delivering high-quality work
  • Highly adaptable and comfortable working with a degree of ambiguity
  • Outstanding written and oral communication skills with the ability to articulate and synthesize information in a compelling and organized manner

Across the Board, VentureWell Staff

  • Are able to succeed and thrive in an environment with competing and changing priorities and tight deadlines
  • Have track records of building solid collaborative working relationships and are proven team players with a customer-service orientation
  • Are committed to embedding equity for all in our internal practices and culture and in our programs to support the mission
  • Bring openness and engagement to personal, professional, and organization-wide learning
  • Are curious and committed to issues of environmental sustainability
  • Are self-starters with excellent attention to detail and a commitment to delivering high-quality work
  • Are active learners who independently learn new tools and work processes quickly
  • Have excellent written and oral communication skills

Our Benefits*

  • An attractive and equitable compensation package, including:
  • a salary range of $70-$80k commensurate with experience and internal equity
  • 403(b) with 200% match up to a maximum contribution from VentureWell of 10% when the employee puts in 5% (eligible after one year of service for the match)
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance
  • $1,000 home office stipend upon hire
  • A true focus on work-life balance with work weeks that reflect that
  • It’s our aim for our employees in this position to not work more than a 35-hour workweek
  • 20 paid vacation days
  • 12 paid holidays
  • 12 paid wellness days

*Benefits are reviewed each fiscal year and may be subject to change.

What We Offer

  • A culture where people work intentionally and collaboratively in pursuit of our mission
  • Values we believe in

About VentureWell

VentureWell supports the cultivation of science and technology inventors and the innovation and entrepreneurship ecosystems critical to their success. Since its founding in 1995, VentureWell has funded or trained over 19,000 early-stage science and technology inventors and innovators, resulting in the emergence of more than 5,800 ventures with groundbreaking technological advancements in fields like biomedicine and healthcare, sustainable energy and materials, and solutions for low-resource settings. The ventures it has supported have raised subsequent funds totaling more than $7.5 billion and are reaching millions of people globally.

Visit venturewell.org to learn more.

description:
The Original Bitcoin Exchange

Inspired by Bitcoin's vision of financial freedom, we are committed to empowering individuals to transact and connect seamlessly across the globe. From the early days of the Bitcoin revolution, our mission has been to champion freedom through innovative, reliable, and accessible technology—ensuring that everyone, everywhere, has the tools to participate in a truly open and borderless world.

We are driven by a relentless pursuit of innovation and financial empowerment. Our forward-thinking, agile approach ensures that financial freedom is not just a vision, but a reality for all.

Our team, composed of visionary individuals with practical expertise, focuses on crafting solutions to the market's toughest challenges. Despite our global presence and impact, we maintain a small, technology-focused core, fostering a culture of collaboration and innovation.

We value integrity and autonomy, empowering our team to contribute from concept to launch. Driven by a passion for lifelong learning and a commitment to advancing freedom, we prioritize high-caliber products and services, with a proven track record of innovation that draws on the dexterity of our teams.

Why Join Us?

Innovation

At Bitfinex, we merge technology and skill to create an environment where your involvement isn’t just appreciated—it’s pioneering the future and pushing boundaries in finance. Our culture values bold creativity, a passion for technology, and a deep belief in Financial Freedom.

Flexibility & Global Reach

We believe in trust, autonomy, and results—our team operates remotely, ensuring you work from anywhere while collaborating with some of the best talents across the world. We thrive on innovation, autonomy, and breaking new ground.

Fast-Paced & Impactful

Much like the crypto industry itself, our projects move fast, break new ground, and make an impact. Your contributions reach our global audience, shaping the narrative of a decentralized future.

A Team that Thrives on Collaboration

We blend seasoned experts with fresh creative minds, ensuring constant innovation, mentorship, and a dynamic work environment that keeps you at the forefront of achieving your goals. We see integrity and standing up for what is right as the most important qualities.

Grow with the Best

At Bitfinex, we’re committed to continuous learning—whether through technological advancements, creative workshops, or mentorship from leading professionals in the industry.

If you’re excited about partaking in shaping the narrative of decentralized finance, you’ll feel right at home

We’re looking for: Community Growth Manager

The Role:

The Community Growth Manager will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and implementing community growth campaigns and strategies across Bitfinex social and community channels.

The candidate will be deeply immersed into the Bitfinex community, and seek to stimulate the community with campaigns and conversation that is attuned to our customer base. As an institutional and professional exchange with large and more sophisticated investors, the Community Growth Manager must be able to speak their language, starting conversations and commenting on markets and Bitfinex events in the style that reflects the Bitfinex brand and the mindset of our customers.

It’s a varied role covering everything from community and reputation management/crisis comms and integrated campaigns, working across all our social channels with a following of over 1 million+ people worldwide. The key focus here is community management - working on the frontline, engaging with our community, highlighting both new developments at Bitfinex and current events in the markets. The candidate will also work with other token project management teams to highlight their tokens on Bitfinex as well as seek to engage with KOLs and influencers who can endorse the Bitfinex brand..

Success will be measured by how engaged the community is and the level of growth seen across the Bitfinex channels. You will monitor and present project updates and provide weekly reports to the senior team and the wider marketing team. Your work will be to support the growth and execution of the marketing strategy.

You will be expected to regularly review the efficiency of campaigns and discover new ways to optimise their growth.

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Develop and implement community growth and management strategies that drive community engagement and increase Bitfinex brand awareness and user acquisition.

  • Conceptualize, categorize, visualize, edit and execute every piece of social content that goes out to the community.

  • Create and manage social distribution plans and schedules that align with wider marketing and business efforts and the social media manager.

  • Define and track key performance indicators and use these to report on your strategies and campaigns to the rest of the team and management.

  • Put our community first, always. Make a positive impact in the hearts of our direct supporters and the larger community. Develop our social customer care strategy in partnership with our support team.

  • Create synergies with the PR team to initiate joint projects which feature a high integration of social.

  • Network with industry professionals and influencers through social media outreach and leverage these relationships to benefit our PR and marketing efforts.

  • Work with our product team to surface valuable customer feedback which can inform new product developments.

  • Collaborate with Marketing and Product development teams to create social ‘buzz’ regarding new product launches.

What You Bring to the Table:

  • 3-5 years of work experience in community management/social media management and/or strategy in technology, finance or media.

  • Demonstrated self-starter, with the ability to work in a team environment with minimal oversight.

  • Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal (only applications in English will be accepted).

  • Experience prioritising tasks, managing deadlines, adapting with changing priorities, and balancing short-term needs with long-term strategic initiatives.

  • Proven ability to work in multidisciplinary teams with copywriters, designers, customer support, product managers, etc.

  • Ability to deal with negative sentiment diplomatically, and convert detractors to supporters.

  • Ability to use data to communicate and report how social goals, strategy and results, and how these relate to wider business aims.

  • Ability to work with visuals, simple gifs, PS assets, videos, etc.

  • Learning & Knowledge Sharing

About Us : Kelley Austin takes a different approach to Salesforce Consulting by putting our employees first. That’s not hyperbole, either. Benefits

  • Work From Home Flexibility

  • Paid Holidays (including an entire week off around Christmas and New Year)

Tools We Use

  • As a technology software consulting company, we use many tools, but the big four are Google Drive, Slack, Lucid Chart, and Salesforce, of course.

Perks Of The Job

  • You won’t really find egos here. We hire slowly and purposefully to keep our culture strong and our team cohesive.
  • We don’t say yes to every client and are not afraid to part ways with a client, either. If there’s no mutual respect or success involved, we politely decline and help them find a different partner. That means fewer ‘tough’ clients and more clients who “get it” and work harmoniously together.
  • We offer half a dozen different clubs like book club, health club, movie club, hobby club, and more. These bring people together to grow intellectually and get to know one another outside of project work.
  • We work an average of 40 hours per week (I know, that’s unheard of in consulting, but we stand by it).

About You

We are seeking a Data Migration Specialist with deep hands-on expertise in Salesforce, Salesforce SOQL, Salesforce APEX, relational databases, SQL, scripting, and large-scale data migration. This role is highly execution-focused and detail-oriented — you will be designing and running ETL processes, writing queries and scripts, validating data quality, and ensuring successful end-to-end migrations between enterprise systems.

Responsibilities

  • Plan, execute, and manage end-to-end data migration projects, including extraction, transformation, loading, and validation.
  • Write and optimize complex SQL and SOQL queries for data validation, migration, and reconciliation.
  • Build, configure, and run ETL jobs to move and transform data across Salesforce, ERP, and external databases.
  • Develop and maintain automation scripts (APEX, Python, Shell, PowerShell, or similar) for data processing, cleansing, and quality checks.
  • Perform data profiling, mapping, and transformation to meet business and technical requirements.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve migration issues such as data mismatches, performance bottlenecks, and integrity errors.
  • Collaborate with internal and external Salesforce, integration, and business teams to coordinate cutovers and validate migrated data.
  • Document migration procedures, scripts, mappings, and reconciliation steps for repeatability and compliance.
  • Ensure all migrations follow best practices for data quality, security, and governance.

Required Technical and Professional Expertise

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent hands-on experience).
  • 5+ years of direct experience in data migration, ETL, or database engineering roles.
  • Strong technical expertise in relational databases (Salesforce, Oracle, SQL Server, or similar).
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL (query optimization, joins, stored procedures).
  • Practical experience with Salesforce SOQL, APEX, and Salesforce data model.
  • Proven track record in data migration projects, including reconciliation and cutover planning.
  • Hands-on scripting skills in Python, Shell, PowerShell, or similar.
  • Familiarity with ETL tools, APIs, and bulk data processing.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) is a plus.
  • Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and ability to deliver under tight deadlines.
